crossRefs.note: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God; for no one understands; but in the Spirit he…
What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit…
Otherwise if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving…
However in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than…

translations.web: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.
translations.bsb: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.
translations.kjv: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
translations.asv: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
